title: Ask Cursor to Build a Full-Stack App Using Blink (Step-by-Step)
summary: Cursor writes the code. Blink provides the backend. Here's how to go from a plain-language prompt to a production full-stack app using the Blink plugin in Cursor.
body_markdown: The Blink plugin installs 14 agent skills and 80+ MCP tools into Cursor covering: database provisioning and schema management, user auth setup, file storage, backend deployment, environment secrets, and custom domain configuration. Cursor's agent can provision real infrastructure by calling these tools directly.
